page.notes: Hebrew forms are approximated from a heavily blurred scan; many Hebrew words are doubtful and should be checked against the original. Latin abbreviations and the number "II." (Jef. 32. 11) are doubtful. The running head, the page number and the catchword are read from very faint Hebrew letters. The top-left page number may be "314" or an inverted form. The letter headers (ע ק, ער) are bare letters, so they are written as paragraphs. The Hebrew in the first two entries of the left column and the Hebrew in the header "עֵר premere" are the least certain.
